scope: Single bounded60ms CPU-only reproduction using the actual prepareHidden join and prepareBossShaders helper. No source modifications.
proof: The shader Promise has no resolve/reject path, and cancellation is only checked after awaiting it. Therefore both jobs remain pending indefinitely, not merely until the next render frame. Prior resolved-later tests did not cover this case.
library: Babylon9.31 Material.forceCompilationAsync wraps forceCompilation without timeout or cancellation. forceCompilation schedules readiness again every16ms until ready/error/scene-engine disappearance. A simple Promise.race can detach our JS waiter but cannot cancel that private polling chain.
